name: Feedback
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Report a bug or idea about anything on your Omarchy desktop in one keypress. Feedback grabs a screenshot you can mark up, the window and shortcut events that led up to it (never typed text) and an optional screen replay, then hands the issue straight to Rix or your coding agent to fix, or opens a prefilled GitHub issue for the author. Passwords and keys are masked before anything is saved. Local issue list and web viewer with PDF and Markdown export.

barWidget.description: Bug chip: your feedback issues, report an issue, arm the screen replay, and hand issues to Rix, your coding agent, or the author.
